external_inputs: User confirms no external approved settings or labelled recording bundles were supplied.

proposed_settings_for_review.status: unapproved proposals only; not used for collection, calibration or fitting

scope_options.tradeoff: Supported achieved-coverage contract; needs a new independently labelled, grouped dataset. Existing factual benchmark rows do not qualify.

scope_options.population: Independently labelled direct-fact QA with audited evidence resources
scope_options.tradeoff: Closer to current benchmark topics; requires a reviewed evidence/public-coverage repair before fitting, plus complete real recordings.

loss_and_threshold_options.meaning: Equal directional error penalties; uncertainty costs one fifth of an error.
False acceptance costs five times false rejection; stronger directional threshold. No benefit is assumed.

shared_candidate_settings.cost_units: ms, conditional on compatible measured calibration
shared_candidate_settings.budget_formula: B_ms = sum of measured mean attempt costs for every eligible candidate; require B_ms > 0
shared_candidate_settings.resource_weight_formula: 0.1 / B_ms loss per ms; a full-budget team adds 0.1 loss. Actual ms values remain unknown.
shared_candidate_settings.warmup_rule: exclude explicitly marked warmup attempts from cost estimates; retain every calibration failure
shared_candidate_settings.split_proposal: Assign whole audited related-example groups: 20% history, 40% development, 40% final; group counts and achievable allocation require approval before collection.
shared_candidate_settings.sensitivity_proposal: Development-only resource multipliers 0, 0.05/B_ms, 0.1/B_ms and 0.2/B_ms; threshold candidates 0.55 and 0.75. Final outcomes stay sealed; freeze the selected specification before release.
shared_candidate_settings.not_supplied: Independent corpus/label provenance, exact group roster/counts, resource observations/pathways, measurement setup, producer factory/exporter, freeze witness and primary/confirmatory analysis approval.

proposed_settings_for_review.interpretation: Normative engineering candidates for user review, not scientific calibration or evidence of improvement. Scope and loss profile may be reviewed independently. Templates remain invalid.
